This function now encapsulates the logic for handling cluster state errors, allowing `processCommand()` to focus on command execution without redundant checks. The introduction of the error code in `getNodeByQuery()` directly influences how commands are processed in `redis.c`, ensuring that commands targeting keys are appropriately redirected when the cluster is down. Overall, the changes enhance code clarity and maintainability while ensuring consistent behavior regarding cluster state handling.
